airport.name: Indira Gandhi International Airport
airport.disclaimer: Terminal footprints, gates, facilities and levels are derived from OpenStreetMap and are not field-verified. Hall, entrance, security and gate connectors are inferred schematic links, not surveyed corridors. Follow airport signs and staff instructions.
airport.liveFlightSource: Live provider lookup when configured; manual entry and demo flights always work. The BLR airport board is used only for BLR.

notes: A complimentary shuttle connects T1, T2 and T3 for passengers with a connecting flight; other passengers pay a small fee.
Shuttles are published as running every 20 minutes, 24x7. T3 stop: arrival forecourt near Pillar 10. T2 stop: arrivals near VIP parking. T1 stop: Lane 1 arrivals.
Allow extra time for the coupon desk, security and baggage steps. Transfer eligibility remains an airline/airport decision.
shuttle.source: Delhi Airport Inter-Terminal Shuttle Service (newdelhiairport.in), retrieved 2026-11-02
shuttle.geometrySource: Straight-line schematic connector between mapped terminal halls
